business_problem: Democratizing connectivity As IoT connected devices grow at unprecedented rates, the telecommunications industry is facing a connectivity revolution.
solution_summary: Democratizing connectivity As IoT connected devices grow at unprecedented rates, the telecommunications industry is facing a connectivity revolution. Connectivity – any time, any place Telefónica Tech saw the potential of uniting IoT and Big Data under one umbrella company. Telecommunications companies are exploring complex 5G, IoT, and AI technologies that will improve real-time user experiences. The company’s mission is to democratize IoT connectivity; essentially, it wants connectivity to be available to everyone, everywhere. “Three years ago, we created a new global company dedicated to making the IoT vision a reality,” explains Carazo. “We combined IoT and Big Data in one company to maximize our focus on the latest technology and big data insights.” He adds: “MongoDB’s scalability puts us at ease. “What we have with MongoDB goes beyond a normal client-supplier relationship.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the high-volume operational and event data that underpins Telefónica Tech's real-time analytics platform.

data_flow: Operational events, telemetry, or transaction data are ingested into MongoDB Atlas, enriched or filtered where needed, retained for fast query access, and served to analytics, monitoring, or customer-facing workflows in near real time. Upstream and downstream integrations include APIs, big-data pipelines.
business_outcome: A data platform for the future Telefónica Tech now thrives on a secure and flexible, modern, multi-cloud database platform that reacts rapidly to fast-moving demands.
metrics: “The platform runs 115,000 queries per second, or 30,000 database inserts per second,” Carazo says.
architecture_clues: The deployment is designed for multi-cloud flexibility.
The deployment integrates with big-data pipelines.
